name: John Yang (@jyangballin) / X
bio: CS PhD @Stanford. Creator of @SWEbench (multi-lingual/modal); SWE-agent; SWE-smith; SWE-sweep; InterCode; CodeClash; ProgramBench

tweets.text:
Another great whole-repo-generation benchmark led by fantastic @HantianDing!\
\
My main learning from Hantian's work - there's a lot of creative ways to go about getting a model to build out a repo from scratch. ProgramBench gives an executable. E2E-SWE gives a specification.

Introducing E2E-SWE, a benchmark for reliably measuring how well coding agents turn a specification into a working software repository.\
\
Agents start from an empty workspace, work offline, and succeed only when their project installs and passes every hidden functional test. https://t.co/ajI0v2YqMK

SWE-sweep on the Gemini 4 Carbon model card! Congrats @OfficialLoganK @Google and the Gemini team on the fantastic numbers!\
\
Follow @KLieret for leaderboard updates, a lot of new numbers coming in :D

Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon, it's a big jump over Argon which we released just 2 weeks ago.\
\
Gemini 4 Carbon is SOTA on cyber, long horizon tasks, ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis V5, significantly improves on usability in domains like coding, and is more aligned. https://t.co/Ikk9YedjCQ

SWE-sweep, SWEeper-bench, now PROBE.\
\
Many coding benchmarks in the past year have gone in the direction of proposing harder versions of tasks w/ fundamentally the same SWE-bench style formulation.\
\
In comparison, proactivity is a great direction - much less about making things

New paper: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix\
\
In proactive bug finding, agents report fewer than 20% of the bugs humans fixed. But they report a lot of other bugs, most of which are valid. This points towards an important distributional mismatch. https://t.co/8nwKJJL2ib

Saturating a benchmark that tests models on rebuilding ffmpeg is gonna take a fraction of the 3 yrs it took to saturate GitHub issue resolution.\
\
Crazy times we live in. https://t.co/F4Fzpc5Zws

How much of SQLite, FFmpeg, PHP compiler can LMs code from scratch? Given just an executable and no starter code or internet access.\
\
Introducing ProgramBench: 200 rigorous, whole-repo generation tasks where models design, build, and ship a working program end to end. 🧵 https://t.co/8ayeDJLXaJ
